assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring was ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring was rendered under CPT 93229
The service was rendered under diagnosis codes I25.10 and R00.2
The denial code CO-197 was based on a missing precertification
The service is consistent with SilverBridge Advantage coverage requirements
